'''2020 Fourth Annual GEMPC''' (the 4th GEMPC) was the [[Anthony Howard|Batmouse]]-organised online match-play championship on [[GEMP]]. [[Chris Gogolen]] beat [[Jared Napolitano]] in the final on 4 April 2020.<ref name="slack-gempc4">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 4 April 2020: “The Finals of the 4th GEMPC will take place today @ 1pm EST b/t 1 gogolen & 4 jnapolit31.”; “Congrats to gogolen for winning the 4th GEMPC, joining zlorfik, allstarz97 and Steviegets as winners of this annual event. Thanks to batmouse for organizing another great tournament, and all participants!”</ref>
